Definition: Adnah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Adnah = "pleasure"; 1) a Manassite who deserted from Saul and joined David at Ziklag; 2) a captain in charge of over 300,000 men of Judah in the time of Jehoshaphat
